$comment: The predefined runs of ./rr report: per scenario, per emitter, the sizes, seeds and options. A list in options measures every value as its own variant. Sizes and seeds live only here, per framework.

$bench.$comment: ./rr bench: one app per framework, at the largest size every framework builds in every scenario.

marko.$comment: Only state=local (the default) is measured, here and in unique-components and big-component: the root-state variants cannot clear a number input's pending edit inside a tag, so a same-value write from the root leaves stale text (see frameworks/marko/README.md).

react.$comment: compiler=off is create-vite's react template, compiler=on its react-compiler template; the source is the same (frameworks/react/README.md).

tea-inline.$comment: lists=none is the variant without keyed lists (README, "The first widgets"), measured so an approach without keyed lists yet can be compared on it.

beni-inline.$comment: lists=none only: browser-inline does not compile a For yet, so every app with a keyed list is refused at build time (frameworks/beni-inline/README.md).

big-component.$comment: No digest: on the flat form it fails the prototype locality rule (calls per local action grow 8.6x from N=16 to 256, 14x from 64 to 1024), so it is excluded until fixed; see frameworks/digest/README.md (big-component) and notes/2026-10-16-big-component-digest-flat.md.

also.digest: fails the locality rule here (calls per local event grow 8.6x from N=16 to 256); timed for reference only

tea-inline.$comment: lists=none is the variant without keyed lists (README, "The first widgets"), measured so an approach without keyed lists yet can be compared on it.

beni-inline.$comment: lists=none only: browser-inline does not compile a For yet, so every app with a keyed list is refused at build time (frameworks/beni-inline/README.md).

$bench.$comment: N=1 only: the js-framework-benchmark app, the calibration point (scenarios/big-table/README.md); growth with N is left to ./rr work.
./rr bench: one app per framework at N=64, the size the dashboards bench at; p1 to p5 carry the actions (harness/bench/routed-app.js), the other pages exist only to be left unmounted.

derived-graph.$comment: An entry is sizes 1 to 256 and seeds 1 to 3 plus "options": { "fanout": ["low", "mid", "high"] }, which measures each readers-per-value level as its own variant (solid, solid-fanout=low, solid-fanout=high); see scenarios/derived-graph/README.md. A list of an emitter's own style parameter (vanilla and Elm: derived) is multiplied with the fanout list, so each style is measured at all three fanout levels (6 vanilla and 9 Elm variants).

$bench.$comment: N=64 with the default 2,000 items: the dashboards' bench size; the work actions as do/undo pairs (harness/bench/derived-graph.js).

also.digest: fails the locality rule here (calls per local event grow 17x from N=16 to 256); timed for reference only

tea-local.$comment: Only quiet=analysed (the default) is measured: quiet=none, plain tea-local, fails the prototype locality rule here (a note keystroke grows 10.1x from N=16 to 256) and is a recorded dead end; see frameworks/tea-local/README.md (derived-graph) and notes/2026-10-17-derived-graph-tea-local.md.
